# Button token migration keeps state-specific consumers together and moves subdialog styling to shared common

The historical port updates button dimension, border, background, text and primary-state tokens together with their owned consumers, including contrast variants. It also removes the duplicated subdialog button rule from Linux/macOS/Windows files and adds it once to shared common.css. Current platform files import that shared style; current rule uses later logical min-block-size, and token overrides have evolved further. This is a scoped style ownership/token contract, not a universal renaming rule or proof of unchanged cascade/rendering. Upstream port body and live UI were not inspected or run.

Scope: Content button tokens and platform subdialog style ownership.
